notes.title: Dear users,
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37973156/e618e7825a00bb1ea7b5386c21aabfd1398aeb17.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37973156/d81787944d17f746d598e816c7d26a66df68f63e.jpg[/img][/url][b]Dear users,[/b]

We deeply regret the inconvenience caused. The keys initially provided were press keys and, for this reason, were deactivated. At the time, we were not aware of any draw or the number of keys requested as part of the press. As developers, we do not deal directly with the marketing side, but we are committed to providing you with an effective solution.

To solve this problem, we are responding to each user. We ask you to provide us with your email address so that we can send you official passwords that have no expiration date. We sincerely apologize for what happened. We have already sent the new passwords to the corresponding organizers to avoid future inconveniences.

We want to make it clear that this incident did not originate with any bad intentions towards the users. Simply, due to the lack of knowledge of the issue, it was not handled correctly at the time. However, we are working hard to correct the situation.

In addition, we are pleased to inform you that the Viral Execution update is now available. We remind you that this game was developed in just 6 months as part of a contest inspired by that year's virus, and has subsequently received numerous improvements.

We thank you for your understanding and look forward to your prompt response with the requested information. With much respect, we send you a big hug.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37973156/2529a526399316deb9e0d300d202023f191e3cb8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Challenge your limits in Viral Execution!
notes.notes:
Dive into the world of [b]Viral Execution[/b] and face 10 levels full of action and strategy. With five difficulty modes, your mission is clear: manage your scarce ammo, find all the antidotes and reach the objective before time runs out. Only the most skilled will survive this epic challenge.[b] Do you have what it takes to win?[/b] Find out now!

notes.title: Version 1.0 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Final version 1.0 NOW AVAILABLE[/h1].

We have updated the game to correct several problems, besides other important changes:

- Changed the name of the game to a more appropriate one.
- Changed the intro of the game.
- Modified the hud during the game.
- Added 5 more levels, going from [b]7 to 12[/b].
- Added different enemies, randomly changing their type in each game.
- Added [b]achievements system with 14 in total[/b].
- Change in some sounds of the game.
- b]21 different characters[/b] to choose from.
- [b]5 levels[/b] of difficulty.

The most difficult game on Steam now has its definitive version.
